description: This file implements a client for interacting with Kubernetes custom metrics API, supporting multiple API versions and caching.

classes.name: multiClient
classes.description: A client that can interact with any version of the custom metrics API, managing multiple underlying clients.

classes.name: multiClientInterface
classes.description: A wrapper providing metrics methods scoped to either the root or a specific namespace.

methods.name: getPreferredClient
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred version of the custom metrics client, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: RootScopedMetrics
methods.description: Returns an interface for root-scoped metrics.

methods.name: NamespacedMetrics
methods.description: Returns an interface for namespace-scoped metrics.

methods.name: GetForObject
methods.description: Fetches metrics for a specific object, considering namespace scope.

methods.name: GetForObjects
methods.description: Fetches metrics for multiple objects, considering namespace scope.
